headline: Review of a new RNP 29Z approach procedure use by airlines and flight discrepancy reports for June through October 2026.
summary: Members will look at passenger data and upcoming flight schedules for the coming months. They will also take public comment and discuss setting a regular quarterly meeting date.
items: Opening public comment and questions, 15 minutes
Historical enplanement data (passengers boarding) through October 2026
Upcoming flight schedules during noise-sensitive hours, November 2026 through April, 2026

Use and adoption by airlines of the RNP 29Z approach procedure, which overlays the Harbor Visual Approach (HVA); published by the FAA on April 16, 2026, and available for PWM ATC assignment from June 26, 2026
Review and discussion of flight discrepancy reports for June through October 2026, posted on the Portland Jetport website
Closing questions, discussion, and public comment
Future agenda item requests from committee members
Discussion of setting a regular quarterly meeting date
location: Jetport conference room, second level of the terminal building; also via Zoom

Portland International Jetport 
Noise Advisory Committee Meeting 
Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 6:00 pm 
 
 
This will be a hybrid format meeting.  Attendees may participate in-person at the Jetport conference 
room on the second level of the terminal building or via zoom.

1. Welcome and Introductions  
2. Opening Public Comment / Questions (15 minutes) 
3. Review Passenger, Operations, and Flight Schedule Data. 
a. Historical enplanement Data through October 2026.   
b. Review upcoming flight schedules during noise sensitive hours for November 2026 – 
April, 2026. 
 
4. Update and Report on the Required Navigation Performance RNP 29Z Approach Procedure 
Use and Adoption by Airlines: Committee will review the use to date of the new procedure that 
overlays the Harbor Visual Approach (HVA), which was published by the FAA on April 16, 
2026; but not available for PWM ATC assignment for use until June 26, 2026.    
5. Review and discussion of the flight discrepancy reports for June – October 2026:  Reports are 
posted on the Portland Jetport website at:  https://portlandjetport.org/noise-abatement-
program Scroll down to the section heading “Link To Noncompliance Report Packages”. 
6. Closing Questions/ Discussion / Public Comment 
7. Future Agenda Items:  Committee members may request future agenda items. 
8. Next Meeting:  Committee members will discuss setting a regular quarterly meeting date. 
9. Adjournment
